The full verifier code was read: it explicitly reconstructs all line pair determinants and performs p-adic unit-pivot Smith filtration on 63x63 L at p=2,3,7,11; recorded profiles give invariant factors (1^18,4^2,16^32,32,64,192,4224^6,118272^2). Independent exact arithmetic reproduced the invariant-factor product and matrix-tree expression, which match 2^209 3^9 7^2 11^8; the source p-adic algorithm, not the independent scalar check alone, establishes integral factors. The group is graph critical group, NOT Picard torsion.
